cs.t: Does it have to be Synology? I recently replaced my 17 year old Drobo with a Ugreen NASync DXP4800 Plus, installed TrueNAS on it and couldn't be happier. Beautiful box with specs that Synology can't touch. Manufacturer is fairly new to the NAS game, but hey, I took a chance on Drobo back in the day and that worked out great.
